title: Oliver Twist
author: Charles Dickens
summary: An orphan born in a workhouse runs away to London and falls in with a gang of child pickpockets led by Fagin. Meanwhile, hints appear that his origins may be more important than anyone realises.
readIf: you want Dickens at his most dramatic, with vivid villains and a strong social conscience.
skipIf: you would struggle with its antisemitic stereotype of Fagin or with scenes of abuse.

pairings.reason: Another Dickens orphan story, more mature, with a subtler and more complex hero.
A bigger, French tale of poverty, crime and compassion.
A far shorter Dickens tale that makes a similar plea for kindness toward the poor.
